guard: the re-grant an elevated-view refusal prints carries the row's REAL current values, so running it adds a scope and changes nothing else, rather than resetting the row to the wide default
why: `cotal actor grant` is an upsert of the WHOLE row and `runActor` fills every omitted flag with a
WIDE default (`>` read, `>` post, `spawn,role:default` scope). This refusal printed a re-grant
naming --scope and nothing else, described as replacing the scope LIST, so an operator adding one
view to a deliberately narrow row reset its read and post sets to `>` in the same paste, and the
same sentence sent them to `cotal actor list`, which shows the widened row and reads as
V1 is that shipped text, byte for byte.
V2 exists because a security lens showed that the first version of the fix was still wrong and the
first version of the CELL could not see it. Naming the flags is not enough: a command printing
`--allow-subscribe '<its current read set>'` looks paste-ready, fails on an invalid channel, and
the operator's shortest route to a command that SUCCEEDS is to delete the flag or write `>`, which
is the wide default again. So the cell grades the printed values against the row on disk, and V2
prints `>` with the flags correctly named. Under V2 the flags-are-named cell stays GREEN and only
the values-are-real cell reddens, which is the discrimination the lens asked for.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite exchanges against the auth service loaded from
`implementations/auth/dist`, so the command builds it before running and `afterRestore` rebuilds
it, or a restored source would sit behind a mutated dist.

mutations.name: V1 the shipped text: a scope-only re-grant of a whole-row upsert
mutations.replace: `cotal actor grant ${req.actor} --owner ${owner} --scope ${[...(grant.scope ?? []), need].join(",")}  (the upsert replaces the scope list; the operator can confirm with \`cotal actor list\`)`,
mutations.expectRed: the view refusal's re-grant names read AND post, not scope alone, and says the upsert replaces the WHOLE row
mutations.cell: the view refusal's re-grant names read AND post, not scope alone, and says the upsert replaces the WHOLE row
mutations.note: Byte-for-byte the string this repository shipped in every release from v0.11.0. Every other cell in section V stays green: the view is still refused, still 401, still names the gate scope.

mutations.name: V2 the flags are named correctly and the values are the wide default
mutations.expectRed: the ACL values it prints are the row's REAL current sets, not a placeholder and not the wide default
mutations.cell: the ACL values it prints are the row's REAL current sets, not a placeholder and not the wide default
mutations.note: The mutant a name-only cell cannot see, and the reason this config has two mutations rather than one: the command is well formed, every flag present, and running it hands the operator a reader of the whole chat plane. The flags-are-named cell stays green under it.
